exceptions.justification: Memory exhaustion in zod v4's $ZodArray. The advisory range (<4.6.6) is wider than the affected code: this repository imports only the root "zod" entry (3.25.76, v3 API) and nothing from "zod/v4". Not reachable from untrusted input: the only z.array in the codebase is the signing-key set in packages/config, parsed from operator-supplied environment at start-up; the audit metadata schemas contain no array types; request bodies are validated by Fastify against JSON Schema generated from the zod definitions, not by zod at runtime, under Fastify's default 1 MiB body limit. Revisit when migrating to zod 4, which also requires replacing zod-to-json-schema.
